Type: chair
Name: AmazonBasics Multi-Purpose Adjustable Office Drafting Spa Stool with Back Cushion and Wheels - Beige
Colors: Beige
Materials: Faux Leather
Drafting stool with black bonded leather upholstery—ideal for home or workplace 250-pound weight capacity; adjustable seat height (from 20.3 to 25.4 inches) 360-degree swivel; chrome arched base with heavy-duty, dual-wheel casters for smooth maneuverability Supportive back cushion measures 16.5 by 10.2 inches (WxH) Measures 24.4 by 24.2 by 32.5 to 37.6 inches (LxWxH); weighs 18.5 pounds; backed by an AmazonBasics one-year limited warranty
